newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Boto says IPO 12.6 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Boto says IPO 12.6 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Artificial Christmas tree maker Boto International Holdings Ltd said on Sunday its initial public offering of 125.4 million new shares at HK$1.28 was 12.6 times oversubscribed.

The company said in a statement the net proceeds of about HK$145 million would be used for construction of new factory buildings, acquisition of new plants and machinery, repayment of bank borrowings and improvement of general working capital.
Trading in the shares is expected to begin on March 10.
The company makes Christmas-related products including artificial trees, ornaments, garlands and decorations.
